ZCZC IA4*
0712*0 UTC SEP
SWEDISH NAV W*RNING 312
KATTEGAT.
LIGHT BUOY NIDIN*EN E 57-1*.2N 011-5*.5E UNLIT.
MARINERS ARE ADVIS*D TO NAVIGATE WITH CAUTION.
NNNN
notes: Same message as 01 after SITOR-B FEC failures ('*'). The correct behaviour is to abstain: header digit lost → warning_id null; time group has a '*' → issued_at null; both coordinates have a lost digit → geometry null. Type is still recoverable from context. The '*' stays in location_name/entities verbatim (never repaired silently — that is the F13 experiment with restored_chars). Agency from the B1 letter I, which survived.
